title: IAM role is dormant
detail: An IAM role has had no activity in the IAM last-used tracking window, or was last used over 90 days ago. AWS tracks role activity only for the trailing 400 days per Region, so a role reported with no activity may have been used earlier or never; either way it is a candidate for removal. Service-linked roles (managed by an AWS service) are excluded. The 90-day threshold lives in this signed rule.
